conviction_note: Event and session confirmed (IR financial calendar lists 18 Nov 2026 Q3 2026 Financial Results, webcast 09:00 GMT, prior Q3 RNS at 07:00-07:01). The Q3 numbers are not pre-released, but an E&P's quarter is mostly set by public commodity prices and a production guide the company reaffirmed in August, so the only plausible new lines are a FY26 dividend-guide change (30% of post-tax CFFO, high Q3 prices per peer Harbour, offset by a heavy hedge book and working-capital/hedge drag Harbour itself flagged) and Rosebank/Canada/CEO commentary. The sum of findings (+0.9) and the scaled number (+0.22) agree in sign; the gap is because p_up stays near 50: this name fell on its FY25 (-6.6%) and Q1 26 (-3.9%) prints, the bar is unsourced, and the stock's real driver into the print is Brent (down from $117.6 on 30 Oct to ~$80.5 on 16 Nov) and the pending Rosebank decision, neither of which the release resolves.

FY26 dividend guide $500-530m is formula-linked to 30% of post-tax CFFO; a raise is plausible on Q3 prices but hedging and in-year tax damp it. Lean up, unknown
Rosebank consent commentary, Canada deal progress, possibly CEO successor and medium-term outlook: unknown direction

findings.finding: Q3 2026 realised commodity prices were well above H1 (peer Harbour's 9M pre-hedge $92/bbl oil and $17.1/mscf European gas, after Harbour raised its FY26 FCF outlook to c.$2.6bn on 5 Nov), and Ithaca's FY26 dividend guide ($500-530m) is a fixed 30% of post-tax CFFO, so a further dividend-guide raise in the Q3 release is plausible, as on 19 Aug when the guide went up and the stock rose 2.4%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 19 Aug 2026 H1 results with dividend guide raised from $470-520m to $500-530m: +2.4% on the day (251.6p to 257.6p), +4.1% the next session (Yahoo chart). Q3 2025 reaffirmed the dividend and fell 2.56%
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: analysts mark CFFO to the strip, but the guide only changes when the company says so, and the stock fell 18% from 312.6p (29 Oct) to ~256p while Brent dropped from $117.6 to ~$80.5, so the market is selling forward prices, not the high-price Q3 cash that funds this year's formula dividend. If it were priced, the dividend raise would be in the share price already, and a stock trading with Brent down 31% does not look like that. Harbour's own caveat (working-capital build and hedge effects) and Ithaca's large hedge book (58.8 mmboe built in a high-price environment) cut this down, so it stays small
findings.independence: Ithaca's own H1 RNS sets the 30% of post-tax CFFO formula and the $83/boe H1 pre-hedge price: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ithaca-energy--ith/first-half-results-six-months-to-30-june-2026/9728521; Equinor's Q3 2026 results also doubled on higher prices: https://www.equinor.com/news/equinor-third-quarter-2026-results

findings.finding: Production momentum into Q4 is company-documented: Q2 a record 131 kboe/d, H1 128 against a 120-130 guide, Cygnus C14 first production due in November, Captain B15 re-drill producing from Q4 and Elgin-Franklin wells starting in Q4, so a reaffirmed or upper-half-narrowed FY production guide is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 said production was 'trending to the bottom end of the range' (Captain shutdown extended) and the stock fell 2.56%; H1 2026 reaffirmed on record Q2 production and rose 2.4%
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it lands inside a guide the company already gave, so it is sized near zero. What is not in the price is any Q3 outage; none was found for Captain, Cygnus, Elgin, Schiehallion or Mariner, which leaves a narrowing toward the top as the small residual upside
findings.independence: Q3 2025 release shows the Q3 print is where Ithaca positions production within the range: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ithaca-energy--ith/third-quarter-update-and-results-/9242765

findings.finding: The Canadian acquisition is financed without equity: the $1.8bn RBL was extended to 2032 at better pricing with a $1bn accordion, Fitch went to watch positive, and the deal is guided as immediately cash-flow and dividend accretive, with deal-contingent hedges done. The Q3 release will update financing and leverage.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 5 Oct 2026 deal announcement: +2.2% (275.4p to 281.4p), then -2.6% the next day; 12 Oct RBL amendment: +0.6%
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since all three items went out by RNS in October. The residual is only that leverage numbers in the Q3 release show the deal fits 'comfortably within our capital allocation leverage ceiling'. The money buys producing, low-decline barrels (~30 kboe/d 2027-31), so the sign is positive. Sized near zero

baseline_tension: The small positive lean agrees with the baseline's priced_lean (+0.63, the run-up mean-reversion term) and cuts against the momentum of a stock down 12.6% in 20 days with Brent. That momentum is macro, not company news, and the release cannot reverse it, which is why p_up is held at 52 rather than higher.
